                    ### Question
                    In a two compartment distribution model, what do the following volumes represent: volume of distribution in stationary equilibrium state, extrapolated volume and beta volume or area volume ?:

                    ### Options
                    opa. They are apparent volumes of total distribution.
opb. The physiological volume in which the drug is distributed.
opc. The total volume of water in the body in which the drug dissolves.
opd. The volume of the peripheral compartment.

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
In a two compartment distribution model, the volume of distribution in stationary equilibrium state represents the apparent volume in which the drug is distributed. The extrapolated volume is the theoretical volume needed to contain the total amount of drug in the body at the observed concentration. The beta volume or area volume typically represents the volume of the peripheral compartment. These volumes are apparent volumes of total distribution.
